in_marathi.name: Ujjwala
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lamp, Light, Knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ujjwala हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ujjwala means 'Lamp' or 'Light' in Sanskrit and Hindi. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'ujj' meaning 'to illuminate' and 'jwala' meaning 'lamp' or 'light'. The name signifies the light of knowledge and wisdom, and is also associated with the eternal flame of the goddess of wealth and prosperity, Lakshmi. It is a powerful and auspicious name for a baby girl.
